TABLE.NAME: tool_canvasuplifter_jobs
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per Canvas-to-Moodle analyse or build run.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: analyse | build — whether this run produces a report or a course.

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course category the new course will be created in.

FIELD.NAME: fileid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the stored package file, or NULL until a URL job's task fetches it.

FIELD.NAME: packageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote package URL to fetch in the task, when the run was started from a URL rather than an upload.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The created course's id, or NULL if not built yet.

FIELD.NAME: report
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded analyse or build report (counts, warnings, items skipped).

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent complete, 0-100. Updated by the adhoc task.

FIELD.NAME: progressmessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-form status message displayed beside the progress bar.
